context_for_next_testing_agent: iter25/iter26/iter22 test files use module-level STATE dict and MUST be run sequentially (-n 0) — running them under the default xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope causes cross-worker KeyErrors that are NOT real regressions. Split runs: (a) stateful group with -n 0, (b) stateless files with default xdist. CORS is fully green and needs no more attention.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: browser fetch showed 'Network Error' from the static preview origin because FastAPI's CORSMiddleware was returning Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* while axios sent credentialed requests (withCredentials:true). Browsers reject ACAO:* with credentials, so preflight/response was blocked before any status could be inspected. Fix: (1) set axios withCredentials=false (Bearer token in Authorization header is used for auth, no cookies needed), and (2) FastAPI CORS allow_credentials=False + allow_origins=['*']. Verified: preflight returns ACAO:* with no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header; both unauthenticated and authenticated calls from the static origin succeed at the CORS layer. Static preview URL itself may still serve stale cached JS bundle until Cloudflare/static rebuild — dev/dynamic URL confirms the fix.
